description: Unit test class 'SynchronizeNotesTest' for testing the synchronization behavior between local notes and remote notes, covering various edge cases and scenarios in the synchronization process.

classes.name: SynchronizeNotesTest
classes.description: Test suite for verifying synchronization logic between local and remote notes, including various scenarios such as empty lists, conflicts, deletions, and different provider types.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes static mocking for Log and sets up common mock behavior before each test.

methods.name: `empty local and remote notes returns empty result`
methods.description: Verifies that synchronization with no local and remote notes yields no updates or actions.

methods.name: `local notes without mapping should be created remotely`
methods.description: Checks that local notes without existing mapping are created on the remote service.

methods.name: `remote notes without mapping should be created locally`
methods.description: Checks that remote notes without existing mapping are created locally.

methods.name: `local note newer than remote note should update remote`
methods.description: Ensures that newer local notes trigger updates to remote notes.

methods.name: `remote note newer than local note should update local`
methods.description: Ensures that newer remote notes trigger updates to local notes.

methods.name: `deleted local note should delete remote note`
methods.description: Verifies that deletion in local notes results in remote deletion actions.

methods.name: `deleted remote note should trigger local delete action`
methods.description: Verifies that remote deletions trigger local delete actions.

methods.name: `file storage service should use storageUri instead of remoteNoteId`
methods.description: Verifies correct handling of file storage provider using storage URI.

methods.name: `title sync - empty local and remote notes returns empty result`
methods.description: Tests title-based synchronization with empty lists results in no actions.

methods.name: `title sync - local notes without matching remote title should be created remotely`
methods.description: Tests creation of remote notes when local notes have titles not present remotely.

methods.name: `title sync - remote notes without matching local title should be created locally`
methods.description: Tests creation of local notes when remote notes have titles not present locally.

methods.name: `title sync - local note newer than remote note with same title should update remote`
methods.description: Ensures local notes with newer modification dates update remote notes sharing the same title.

methods.name: `title sync - remote note newer than local note with same title should update local`
methods.description: Ensures remote notes with newer modification dates update local notes sharing the same title.

methods.name: `title sync - notes with same title and similar timestamps should not create actions`
methods.description: Checks that no redundant actions are taken when notes with same title and timestamps are synchronized.
